notes.title: Minor Update (19.02)
notes.notes:
[b]- Added realistic water.[/b] Better underwater effects

[b]- Reworked lightning.[/b] Better transitions between night and day

[b]- Day cycle is now longer.[/b] It takes approximately 5 minutes to run

[b]- Building area was increased[/b]. Now you can build up to 20 blocks in height and 9 in width.
